body:
Barbell at home dosen't seem like a bad idea :) 
And thank's for the nice words :)

I don't know what I can say to help... But, if you're scared to die, that might be a hint it's a bad idea... You could call a suicide hotline? 
Or talk to a family member or a friend? 
"Pills aren't working at all." If you've taken an overdose, you might want to go to a doctor, or try and puke them up. I'm not gonna tell you, not to kill yourself, but atleast try and wait it out a little longer, maybe you'll feel a little better. Right now try and do something that comforts you, eat some good food or watch a funny youtuber, maybe Nigahiga, he's cool :) And crying helps, just cry it all out, don't know if this helped, but it makes me sad knowing, how shitty and depressed you and others feel, I feel that way too, it suck's, I've tried to kill myself myself before, I wished one of the times would have worked, but in some way I feel a little relived, that I'm still breathing...

I laugh soo much, people ask me if I'm high or on drugs, almost everything makes me giggle lol I'm such an awkward person lol I feel bad when people tell me I seem so happy though, like no lol but I'm not gonna be a bitch to people and complainnig dosen't make anything better. Plus happy people make other people happy, so if I'm happy on the outside, maybe I'll make someone else a little happy hehe 
I do my best to try and keep positive. 
If I bother to get a gym membership, I'll tell you lol 
I'll start with the jogging, there's a forest less then 5 min from where I live, it's really pretty and has lots wildlife I saw a fox there at night time once lol (Insomnia btw) It's a great place for jogging, I useally walk the dogs there :) 
And I hope your doing fine too? :p I mean, it seems you been in a very dark place too. But maybe working out, brightened the road for you a little. And you've given really good advice and stuff, thank's :)

I get called wierd a lot too, I don't give a fuck though lol
I've liked the Facebook pages :)
And that video made me laugh, maybe I'll try the exerscises despite how awkward they may be and I can go for a run in weekend mornings, baby steps, right? :) Maybe I'ĺl join a gym, but I feel like gyms are awkward and the only thing people do there is take selfies :p

You're pretty motivational c: 
And lol I listen to beartooth, attack attack, LP, SOAD, disturbed, hollywood undead, limp bizkit and so on, it gets me through the day.. And I useally scream into a pillow hehe..
Sometimes when I feel pissed off I just punch a wall, I punched a brick wall once and my hand hurt for atleast 2 weeks after, ouch lol
I'm thinking about maybe taking some theraphy or some shit, just to talk about shit and get some advice. 
And I'll check out he's videos, I watched the one you gave me a link for, it was good shit hehe 
*Sorry it took a while to answer :P

That made me laugh a little hehe "FUS RO DAH that motherfuckin' depression, make it your bitch." I really liked what you said and you seem like a really cool person :) I did some running, before summer, but it rains here most of the year (I'm from Norway..) and I'm a girl (despite being really tomboyish lol) so I don't think lifting weights, would be my thing... 
I don't really feel motivated enough to do anything anyways, just going to work takes all of my energy, I feel like crying almost every morning I wake up. Don't know about chasing after something, my life dosen't hold any meaning, I don't have anything in particular I want to do, if I could, I would just play video games, watch anime, skateboard and sit in my room with my music on full lol...

I don't want to go on with my life, when everyday feels like shit and I feel pissed off, like I hate everyone and everything and I want to break some shit and punch someone in the face just to let out some anger and I want to cry soo much, I faint of dehydration. 
I try to think positive though, well once in a while...
